description: Returns a list of groups for a specified Calendly organization URI, supporting pagination.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving a list of groups associated with an organization.

count.description: The maximum number of groups to return per page. The value can range from 1 to 100.
count.title: Count

organization.description: The URI of the organization to filter groups by. For example, 'https://api.calendly.com/organizations/ORGANIZATION_UUID'.
organization.title: Organization

page_token.description: A token to retrieve a specific page of results. Pass this value from a previous response's 'next_page_token' to fetch the next set of groups, or 'previous_page_token' for the previous set.
page_token.title: Page Token

inputSchema.title: ListGroupsRequest

name: list_groups

Group.description: Represents a single group object returned by the API.

created_at.description: Moment when the group was created in ISO 8601 format.
created_at.title: Created At

updated_at.description: Moment when the group was last updated in ISO 8601 format.
updated_at.title: Updated At

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the group.
uri.title: Uri

Group.title: Group

ListGroupsResponse.description: Response schema for `ListGroups`, containing a collection of groups and pagination information.

collection.description: Array of group objects returned by the API.
collection.title: Collection

ListGroupsResponse.title: ListGroupsResponse

Pagination.description: Pagination information for navigating through result sets.

count.description: The number of rows returned in the current response.
count.title: Count

next_page.description: The URL to retrieve the next page of results. Returns null when there are no more pages.
next_page.title: Next Page

next_page_token.description: The page token to use for retrieving the next page of results.
next_page_token.title: Next Page Token

previous_page.description: The URL to retrieve the previous page of results. Returns null when on the first page.
previous_page.title: Previous Page

previous_page_token.description: The page token to use for retrieving the previous page of results.
previous_page_token.title: Previous Page Token
